noAnchorGaps.concept: Rising OI confirming the rising up-leg (fresh money entering)
noAnchorGaps.quote: As the trend rises here, open interest rises with it — that's fresh money entering, confirming a strong, healthy move.
noAnchorGaps.why: move open_interest exposes only top(pt) and reversal(pt); there is no anchor on the rising up-leg, so this reference cannot be drawn without inventing an anchor

notes: The only CHART beat is 'reading' (move open_interest, stage all). Its accumulated show already labels both valid point anchors: marker at 'top' ("high OI = positions stacked (fuel)", dot/above) matches the say 'positions are now stacked up, and that's fuel'; marker at 'reversal' ("OI falls = positions close / liquidate", sweep/below) matches 'open interest drops sharply — those positions are being closed and liquidated'. Both are anchor-valid, kind/type-correct (marker on point anchor), label-accurate, and non-redundant. The auditor's first two 'gaps' merely restate these existing show items, so no add is needed. The rising up-leg reference is genuinely undrawable (no anchor) and is recorded as a noAnchorGap. The remaining beats (intro, rules, recap) are CONCEPT (no chart) and out of scope. No fixes, no missed gaps.
